# Phase J J0/J1 semantic fixtures

`j0_j1_semantic_fixtures.json` contains synthetic, network-free acceptance
projections. They are not market-source payloads, live captures, or production
Result/Audit artifacts. The fixture envelopes bind Result V3 and Audit V3
identities and provide bounded normalized facts so the acceptance harness can
exercise typed semantic and forbidden-claim checks. Full Result V3 and Audit
V3 schema validation remains covered by the existing contract suites.
